Mr. Behl, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that present FIR relates to an offence punishable under Sections 420/406/34 IPC.
He further submits that the petitioner/applicant is ready and willing to explore the possibility of an amicable settlement with the complainant and prays that the matter may be referred to Mediation.

2. Mr. Goswami, learned counsel for complainant though doubts the bona fide of petitioner,
however, on instructions, states that he has no objection to the same.
He however, prays that a senior mediator may be appointed.

3. Considering the aforesaid, matter be listed before Samadhan, Delhi High Court Mediation &
Conciliation Centre on 26.04.2024.
